name: Bosnia and Herzegovina — needs rollup
blurb: Country-level rollup for **Bosnia and Herzegovina** spanning all 15 needs categories, feeding the global.10B macro-space model. Average indicator coverage: 80%.
mechanism:
Aggregates the 15 per-category models for Bosnia and Herzegovina into a single country needs embedding and a set of tier-level (subsistence / development / agency) satisfaction averages.

Each category model contributes a satisfaction score and a category embedding; the rollup concatenates the embeddings, weights category contributions by indicator coverage, and emits a country-level vector along with a plain-text summary suitable for consumption by a personal agent helping the user navigate community building and economic transition.
